name: Pi-hole
description: Provide network-wide DNS filtering with a locally managed administration interface.
limitations: This KITPro profile provides DNS only; DHCP, NTP, and other optional Pi-hole services are not exposed or supported.
KITPro uses bridge networking without host networking, privileged mode, or added Linux capabilities.
KITPro does not change router or client DNS settings; those settings remain under administrator control.
This profile does not provide high availability or secondary Pi-hole replication.
KITPro does not configure public HTTPS, a reverse proxy, or Internet publishing for the admin interface.
Stopping or removing the Pi-hole runtime can interrupt DNS for clients configured to use this instance.

lifecycle_notice.install: Installing Pi-hole does not change router or client DNS settings. If clients later use this server for DNS, Pi-hole becomes infrastructure-critical.
lifecycle_notice.stop: This operation can interrupt DNS for clients configured to use this Pi-hole instance.
lifecycle_notice.remove: Removing the Pi-hole runtime can interrupt DNS. KITPro retains Pi-hole application data and does not revert router or client DNS settings.
